newsitem.title: USA: Panax president and CFO resign.
newsitem.headline: Panax president and CFO resign.

text.p: Drug company Panax Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said Monday its chairman and chief financial officer had resigned from their posts.
Panax said its president and chief executive, Taffy Williams, will assume the chairman's responsibilities.
It said Armen Takhtajan had resigned as chairman and Norman Eisner as chief financial officer as part of a reorganization of the board of directors.
A company official said the two had not been active board members and Panax was looking to hire people who were specialized in the industry.

In January, Panax agreed in principle to merger with Sangen Pharmaceutical Co of Penn Valley, Pennsylvania. If it goes ahead with the deal, it will give the chairman's post to Sangen's president and chief executive officer and hire two outside directors, it said.
